svg.aria-label: Dot chart: the share of each film's script said word for word on screen, for six directors. Joel Coen, 19 films: median 73%, from Intolerable Cruelty at 27% to The Tragedy of Macbeth at 90%. Billy Wilder, 5 films: median 81%, from The Lost Weekend at 78% to The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes at 85%. Christopher Nolan, 11 films: median 67%, from Interstellar at 9% to Dunkirk at 80%. Quentin Tarantino, 9 films: median 48%, from Django Unchained at 30% to Pulp Fiction at 74%. Martin Scorsese, 16 films: median 48%, from Raging Bull at 21% to Casino at 77%. Steven Spielberg, 21 films: median 37%, from The Post at 7% to War Horse at 96%.
